title: 420. Self Crossing

examples.explanation: The fourth leg lands back on the first leg's line.
The spiral keeps widening, so no legs meet.
A later leg slices through an earlier leg in the compact spiral.

hints: Only the last few legs can meet the current one, so check local patterns at i >= 3, 4, 5.
Compare lengths: a leg crosses when it reaches past the line two steps back while the middle leg overlaps.
